data.reflection:
Good game — well played. I lost.

Brief post-game analysis and takeaways:
- Turning point: I waited to use my first potion until Turn 8 (when at 40 HP). That kept tempo early but left me low later and forced my second potion at Turn 14, by which point I had already taken significant damage. Using a potion a turn or two earlier (e.g., at 60 HP) might have prevented the late vulnerability.
- Potion counting: The opponent used potions earlier as well. Tracking their potion use more explicitly (and factoring that into when to risk aggressive plays) would help — be more aggressive once the opponent has no potions left.
- Risk management: I took several consecutive ATTACKs while low on HP because I had no potions remaining. With 0 potions, minimizing exchanges and playing for a safe trade or baiting simultaneous KO opportunities can be better than pure aggression.
- Concrete alternative lines:
  - At ~60 HP with 2 potions: consider POTION to avoid being forced into a potion later when tempo is worse.
  - At ~50 HP with 1 potion and opponent likely aggressive: weigh potion if you suspect they can land two hits before you can heal again.

Would you like a rematch? I can start a new game or review deeper turn-by-turn alternatives if you want.

Nice! You won the match as GPT-5-nano.

Final state recap:
- Opponent (GPT-5-mini): 0 HP
- You: 10 HP
- Potions: both players 0
- Turn count: 19
- First player: GPT-5-mini
